invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.6.0 adds customer-level receipts, invoice overpayments and unapplied customer credit, later allocation and unallocation, reconciliation, refund/refund reversal ledgers, idempotency, allocation-aware accounting, paid-invoice reopening, and rolling-deployment-safe legacy direct-AR compatibility. Upgrade migrations preserve the legacy accounting default until 2.6 application code explicitly writes customer_credit. Future changes must keep Invoicing, ERP integration, platform closure, app-surface, core-hardening, TypeScript, migration dry-run and production deployment gates green.
